url.description: Url used to access the current action. Can be null if this is not a Rest request.

serverId.description: Url serverId for Rest requests or hostname of the server where this action is being executed.

env.description: Env where the action is being executed.

app.description: App where the action is being executed.

typeName.description: Name of the Type for this action.

userName.description: User id of the user executing this action.

accessControlEntities.description: User + UserGroups + Roles of the Principal executing this action.
